install.q: Do I need to download an app?
install.a: No install needed — Momoto runs right in your browser. You'll create a quick, free account to pick an activity, then just allow your camera.

free.a: Yes — making strips in the photobooth is free, and sharing them costs nothing. Every strip is saved to your cart, where you can optionally unlock a clean, watermark-free copy to download and print for a small fee.

print.q: How do I get a clean, printable strip?
print.a: Each strip you create is saved to your cart with a light watermark. From the cart, tick the strips you want and check out to unlock high-resolution, watermark-free copies you can download and print.

friend.q: Can I use it with a friend?
friend.a: Absolutely. Pick Date mode and share your room code — you'll each see the other's live camera and take the strip together.

privacy.a: Your photos are captured and composed right in your browser. When you create a strip it's saved to your account so it appears in your cart across your devices; in Date mode the live video is streamed peer-to-peer and never recorded.

need.q: What do I need to get started?
need.a: A device with a camera and a modern browser (Chrome, Safari, Edge, or Firefox). Allow camera access when prompted and you're set.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: Welcome to Momoto. These Terms & Conditions govern your use of our playful date experiences — including the Virtual Photobooth and other activities — available in your web browser at momoto and any related apps. By using Momoto, you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the service.

service.title: The Service
body: Momoto is a little studio of playful date experiences built for long-distance relationships. It lets two people in different places share a moment together in real time — snapping a synced photo strip, or playing other activities as we add them.
The service is provided for personal, non-commercial entertainment. Features may change, launch, or be retired over time as we keep improving Momoto.

eligibility.title: Eligibility & Access
body: You must be at least 13 years old to use Momoto. If you're under the age of majority where you live, you may only use the service with the involvement of a parent or guardian.

Momoto requires a free account to access activities — sign up with your email and a password, or with Google. You're responsible for keeping your login details secure and for the device, camera, and connection you use.

content.title: Your Content & Photos
body: Your photos are yours. Photo strips are captured and composed within your own browser. When you save a strip to your cart, the composed image is uploaded to our servers and stored with your account so you can reach it across your devices; you can remove it at any time. We use your strips only to provide the service to you.

In a shared "Date" session, your live camera is streamed peer-to-peer to the friend you invited, so you can pose together. Momoto only relays the connection — it doesn't record or keep that video. What each of you chooses to download or share afterward is up to you.
You are responsible for the content you capture and share, and for respecting the privacy and consent of anyone who appears in it.

payments.title: Purchases & Payments
body: Creating strips, saving them to your cart, and sharing them are free. A clean, high-resolution copy of a strip without the watermark is an optional paid download. Prices are shown at checkout before you confirm, and you can buy several strips in a single order.

Payments are handled by our third-party payment provider, Midtrans. By paying, you also agree to the provider's terms. We receive confirmation that a payment succeeded and an order reference, but we don't collect or store your full card or bank details.

Because a purchase immediately unlocks a digital file for download, paid strips are generally non-refundable once unlocked — except where a refund is required by law, or where a technical fault on our side stops you from downloading a strip you paid for. If that happens, contact us and we'll put it right.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable Use
body: Please use Momoto kindly and lawfully. You agree not to: use the service to harass, threaten, or harm anyone; capture or share unlawful, hateful, or non-consensual content; attempt to disrupt, overload, reverse-engineer, or gain unauthorized access to the service; or use it to infringe anyone's rights.
We may suspend or limit access for anyone who misuses the service or these terms.

availability.title: Availability & Changes
body: Momoto is provided "as is" and "as available," without warranties of any kind. We don't guarantee that the service will always be available, uninterrupted, or error-free — a shared session depends on both people's devices and network connections.

We may add, change, or discontinue features at any time, and we may update these terms. When we do, we'll revise the "last updated" date above; continuing to use Momoto after a change means you accept the updated terms.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Momoto and the people behind it are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the service, including lost photos, missed moments, or interrupted sessions.

Momoto is a playful experience that's free to use, with optional low-cost paid prints — where liability cannot be excluded by law, it is limited to the amount you paid us (if any) for the feature involved, or the minimum permitted.

governingLaw.title: Governing Law
body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia, without regard to its conflict-of-law rules. If a dispute arises, we ask that you reach out to us first so we can try to resolve it amicably.

contact.title: Contact
body: Questions about these terms? Reach out and we'll be happy to help. Thanks for spending a moment with Momoto — we hope it keeps you a little closer, however far apart.

accounts.title: Your Account
body: You're responsible for activity under your account and for keeping your password confidential. Provide accurate information, and don't impersonate others or create an account for someone without their permission.
You may delete your account at any time by contacting us. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. This Privacy Policy explains what little information Momoto handles when you use our playful date experiences at momoto, and how we keep your photos and moments yours. Momoto is designed to be privacy-conscious: your photos are made right in your browser, and we keep what we store to the minimum needed to run your account, save the strips you choose to keep, and handle any prints you buy.

collect.title: Information We Collect
body: To use Momoto's activities you create an account, so we collect the details you provide: your email address, a securely hashed password (we never store it in plain text), your display name, an optional avatar, and — if you add it — the city or regency you live in (or your country and city if you live outside Indonesia). If you sign in with Google, we receive your basic Google profile (email, name, and picture).

When you save a strip, we store the finished image with your account: a watermarked preview and, if you purchase a print, a clean unwatermarked copy. If you buy a print, our payment provider (Midtrans) processes the payment; we receive a confirmation and an order reference tied to your account, but not your full card or bank details.

To run a shared "Date" session, our server briefly handles a temporary room code and the connection details needed to link you and your partner's browsers — the video and audio themselves are relayed peer-to-peer and never recorded.
Like most websites, our hosting may process basic technical data (such as IP address and browser type) in server logs for security and reliability.

media.title: Photos, Video & Audio
body: Your photos are captured and composed entirely inside your own browser. The raw camera frames are never uploaded — only the finished strip you choose to save is. When you save a strip to your cart, that composed image is uploaded and stored with your account so you can find it across your devices (a free version carries a watermark; a purchased copy is clean). You can remove a saved strip from your cart at any time, which deletes it from our servers.

In a Date session, your live camera and microphone are streamed directly to the friend you invited, peer-to-peer. Our server only helps the two browsers find each other (and may relay the stream if a direct connection isn't possible); we do not record, view, or store that video or audio.

storage.title: Cookies & Local Storage
body: Momoto uses your browser's local storage to remember small things that make the app work — such as your language preference and the state of an in-progress session so it survives a refresh. This data stays on your device.
We don't use advertising cookies or third-party tracking pixels.

usage.title: How We Use Information
body: We use the limited information described above only to provide the service: to connect you with your friend in a Date session, to save the strips you choose to keep and make them available across your devices, to fulfill and confirm any prints you buy, to keep sessions running smoothly, and to protect the service against abuse.
We do not sell your data, and we don't use it for advertising or profiling.

sharing.title: Who We Share Data With
body: In a session, the only "sharing" is the live camera and audio you send directly to the friend you invited during a Date session — you choose who that is.

If you're signed in and leave a comment with a 4 or 5-star rating beside a strip, we may feature it on our website as a testimonial, together with your display name, your city or country, your uploaded profile picture and your rating. If your account is linked to a partner at the time, their display name, city or country and uploaded profile picture may appear alongside yours. To have a testimonial removed, contact us using the details below — unlinking also removes your partner from it.

Behind the scenes we rely on standard infrastructure providers (for hosting and for the connection-relay servers that WebRTC needs), and — when you buy a print — a payment provider (Midtrans) to process the transaction, purely to deliver the service. We don't sell or rent your information to anyone.

retention.title: Data Retention & Deletion
body: The strips you save are stored with your account until you remove them from your cart or delete your account, at which point they're deleted from our servers. Photos you don't save stay only on your device — closing the tab or clearing your browser storage removes any local session data. Room codes are temporary and expire when a session ends.
Any basic technical log data our hosting keeps is retained only for a short period for security and then discarded.

children.title: Children
body: Momoto is intended for people aged 13 and over. We don't knowingly collect information from children under 13. If you believe a child has used the service in a way that concerns you, please get in touch.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we'll revise the "last updated" date above. Continuing to use Momoto after a change means you accept the updated policy.

contact.title: Contact
body: Questions about your privacy or this policy? Reach out and we'll be happy to help.

accounts.title: Your Account
body: Your account holds your email, a hashed password (or a linked Google identity), your display name, an optional avatar, and an optional city (or country, if you live outside Indonesia). You can update these any time on your profile page.
You may link your account with a partner using a one-time invite code; either of you can unlink at any time. To delete your account and its data, contact us using the details below.

in-use.title: Camera unavailable
in-use.message: Your camera may be in use by another app. Close it and try again.

insecure.title: Insecure context
insecure.message: Camera access requires HTTPS or localhost.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.message: We could not access your camera. Please try again.

auth.logoutServerError: You've been signed out on this device, but we couldn't reach the server to end your session everywhere.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to pick an activity.
login.panelTagline: Playful date experiences for long-distance relationships.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Sign up to start making moments together.
register.consent: By signing up, you agree to our <terms>Terms & Conditions</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

profile.title: Profile
profile.avatarHint: Up to 15 MB. PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or AVIF — you choose the crop next.
profile.deleteHint: Permanently delete your account and all its data — strips, prints and the partner link.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.subtitle: Your five most recent orders.
purchases.emptyBody: Paying for a strip unlocks the clean, watermark-free copy and moves it into your gallery. Orders show up here once you do.
purchases.loadError: Couldn't load your orders. Please try again.

profile.cropHint: Drag to move, and use the slider to zoom. The circle shows how it will appear.
profile.cropCanvasLabel: Crop area — drag or use the arrow keys to move the picture

partner.title: Your partner
partner.none: Link with your partner to share moments as a couple.
partner.codeHint: Share this code with your partner. It expires in 24 hours.
partner.linkedHint: Your strips are shared as a couple and Date sessions are unlocked.
partner.unlinkHint: Unlinking stops sharing new strips. Nothing already saved is deleted.
partner.generateHint: We make a code you can send to your partner. It expires 24 hours after you generate it.
partner.acceptHint: Linking shares your strips as a couple and unlocks Date sessions.
partner.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — select the code and copy it yourself.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid_credentials: That username or password is incorrect.
errors.registration_closed: Momoto is in closed beta — new accounts are not open yet.
errors.email_taken: An account with that email already exists.
errors.invalid_input: Please check the details and try again.
errors.google_not_configured: Google sign-in isn't available right now.
errors.invalid_google_token: Could not verify your Google sign-in. Please try again.
errors.too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.displayNameInvalid: Display name can only contain letters and spaces.
errors.invite_invalid: That invite code is invalid or has expired.
errors.already_linked: You're already linked with a partner.
errors.partner_linked: That person is already linked with someone else.
errors.usernameInvalid: Username can only contain letters and numbers.
errors.usernameTooShort: Username must be at least 3 characters.
errors.usernameTooLong: Username must be at most 20 characters.

avatar.tooLarge: That image is too large. Pick one under 15 MB.
avatar.notAnImage: That file couldn't be read as an image.
avatar.encodeFailed: That image couldn't be processed. Try a different one.

errors.emailTooLong: That email address is too long.
errors.nothing_pending: There is no address waiting to be confirmed.
errors.invalid_token: That link is no longer valid.
errors.unsupported_image: That image format isn't supported. Use PNG, JPEG or WebP.
errors.image_not_square: A profile picture has to be square. Try another image.
errors.image_too_large: That image is too big. The longest side must be 1024 pixels or less.
errors.storage_unavailable: Couldn't save that picture right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.email_unverified: Confirm your email address before changing your password.
errors.cityInvalid: City can only contain letters, spaces, dots, apostrophes and hyphens.
errors.cityTooLong: City must be 60 characters or fewer.
errors.regionRequired: Please choose a city or regency.

logoutConfirm.title: Log out?
logoutConfirm.description: You'll need to log in again to use activities.
logoutConfirm.descriptionRoom: You're in a live session. Logging out will leave it.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete your account?
deleteConfirm.error: Couldn't delete your account. Please try again.
deleteConfirm.description_one: This removes your account and the {{count}} paid strip in your gallery. It cannot be undone.
deleteConfirm.description_other: This removes your account and all {{count}} paid strips in your gallery. It cannot be undone.
deleteConfirm.descriptionLinked_one: This removes the {{count}} paid strip in your gallery and the link with {{name}}. It cannot be undone.
deleteConfirm.descriptionLinked_other: This removes all {{count}} paid strips in your gallery and the link with {{name}}. It cannot be undone.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Tell us who you are and we'll email you a link to set a new one.
forgot.sentBody: If that account has a confirmed email address, a reset link is on its way. It's good for 30 minutes.
forgot.sentAgain: Another link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Pick something you haven’t used here before.
reset.done: Your password is set. Sign in with it below.
reset.expiredBody: Reset links last 30 minutes and can only be used once. Ask for a fresh one and it will be waiting in your inbox.

verifyEmail.doneBody: This address is now on your account. If you ever forget your password, this is how you get back in.
verifyEmail.failedBody: Confirmation links last 24 hours and can only be used once. Open Profile and send yourself a fresh one.
verifyEmail.takenBody: Another account has already confirmed this email. Use a different address, or sign in to the account that owns it.

email.pendingHint: Waiting for you to open the link we sent. Nothing changes on your account until you do.
email.noneHint: Without an email address there is no way to recover this account if you forget your password.

banner.noneBody: Without one there's no way to get back into your account if you forget your password.
banner.pendingBody: {{email}} isn't confirmed yet. Until you open the link, you can't reset your own password.

email.unconfirmedHint: Not confirmed yet. Send yourself the link and open it — that's what lets you reset your own password.

password.otherDevicesOut: Every other device was signed out.
password.needsVerifiedEmail: Confirm your email first — without one, a forgotten password can’t be reset.

network.offlineBody: No connection right now — we’ll reconnect on our own. Anything you’ve already shot is safe.
network.offlinePage: This device isn’t connected to the internet. Check your wifi or mobile data — this page comes back by itself the moment you’re online.
network.serverBody: Our server isn’t responding properly — this one’s on us. Anything you’ve already shot is safe.
network.unknownBody: We can’t reach Momoto. It could be our server or your connection — either way, anything you’ve already shot is safe.
network.slowBody: Things may take a while to load or save. Nothing you've shot is at risk — this clears itself when the connection picks up.

serverDown.title: Momoto is having trouble
serverDown.message: Our server isn’t responding right now. This one’s on us — hang tight and try again in a moment.
serverDown.unknownMessage: Nothing is getting through at the moment. It could be our server, or something between you and it — worth checking your connection before you try again.

notFound.title: This page doesn’t exist
notFound.message: The link may be broken, or the page may have moved. Let’s get you back to something that works.

beta.message: Momoto is testing with a small group of invited couples. If you were invited, sign in with the details we sent you — new sign-ups aren't open yet.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.scan: Scan this with your payment app.
checkout.expired: This payment expired. Start a new one when you’re ready.
checkout.resumed: You have a payment in progress.
